title: Rebuild World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In a post-apocalyptic world ruled by corporate city-states, homeless slum kid Akira becomes a relic hunter, scavenging lost-civilization ruins guarded by mutant bioweapons and robots. On his first desperate trip he meets Alpha, an incorporeal AI woman only he can see, who offers to guide him in exchange for a mysterious future task. Adapted from Nafuse's light novels, the manga follows Akira's rise through gunfights, gang wars and corporate politics.
life_message: In a harsh world you survive by your own strength and wits, though trust and debts owed to others still matter.
